quote.help: Sends a random quote from a local list.

uptime.help: Shows how long the bot has been running since its last restart.

topcommands.help: Top 5 most used commands (optional: topc <days>, default 24 h)

status.help: status shows uptime, radio, contacts and the last error (admin).

toprepeaters.help: Top 3 busiest repeaters (optional: topr <days>, default 24 h)

topusers.help: Top 5 most active users (optional: topu <days>, default 24 h)

whois.help: Looks up a known node by name or key prefix (name, role, last seen, hops, location, game level).

feestdag.none: {label} ({date}): no official holiday in NL or BE.

file.help: Traffic jams and incidents within 20 km of a place (NDW open data, NL).

f1.game_none_good: Nobody got the winner or a podium spot right

f1.predict_duplicate: Each driver only once in your top 3.

f1.live_only_none: F1: this only works during a session, and no session is planned right now.

f1.no_grid: F1: no starting grid known yet.

f1.no_pits: F1: no pit stops in this session yet.
f1.no_sprint: F1: no sprint result this season yet.
f1.me_dm_only: You see your own standing by DM: send me f1 me
f1.me_none: You are not in the F1 game yet. DM me: f1 predict VER
f1.me: F1 game {season}: {points} pts in {races} races, place {place} of {players}

rptr.no_service: rptr: the Home Assistant link is off. Turn HARepeater on in Plugins and restart the add-on.
rptr.no_ha_data: rptr: no data from Home Assistant yet, try again shortly{why}

rptr.not_found: rptr: no repeater found{what}. Type rptr list.
rptr.battery_too_few: Battery {name}: only {n} reading(s) stored so far, try again later
rptr.help: rptr shows battery, uptime, airtime and neighbours of the repeater; rptr buren = the neighbours; rptr accu [7d] = battery history; rptr list = all repeaters.

helpall.bad_page: Help: page {page} does not exist (1-{total} available).
helpall.help: Full list of channel commands (no admin/DM-only): 'helpall' for page 1, then 'helpall 2', 'helpall 3', ...

info.help: info bot tells what this bot is and what you need for a bot of your own (DM only).

quiz.wrong: Sorry, wrong. You said {given}, the correct answer was {letter}) {answer}.
quiz.already_active: A quiz question is already running on this channel - answer with quiz a/b/c/d.
quiz.question: Quiz: {question}
quiz.help: Sends a multiple-choice trivia question. Answer within 60 s with 'quiz a', 'quiz b', 'quiz c' or 'quiz d'. Questions in English.

hangman.already_running: A game is already running on this channel. {status}
hangman.no_game: No active game. Start with 'hangman start'.
hangman.wrong_word: Sorry, wrong guess. The word was: {word}
hangman.lost: Out of guesses. The word was: {word}
hangman.unknown_action: Unknown hangman action. Use: start [category], <letter>, raad <word>, stop.
hangman.help: Letter guessing game. 'hangman start [category]' starts a game (categories: {categories}). Guess with 'hangman <letter>' or 'hangman raad <word>'. 'hangman stop' stops.

poll.no_active: No active poll on this channel.
poll.already_active: A poll is already running on this channel - 'stem uitslag' or wait for it to end.
poll.question_too_long: Question too long (max ~{max} characters), try a shorter one.
poll.help: Starts a yes/no vote: 'stem <question>' (question max ~80 characters, or the message will not fit). Optionally a duration first (exactly one, do not combine): 'stem 15m <question>', 'stem 2h <question>' or 'stem 1d <question>' (default 10 min, max 1 day). Others vote with 'ja'/'nee' (yes/no). 'stem uitslag' shows the count so far, 'stem stop' ends the vote early.

botlist.none: Botlist: no manual names. Automatic: robot emoji or the word bot in the name.
botlist.added: Botlist: {name} now always counts as a bot{note}.
botlist.excluded: Botlist: {name} never counts as a bot{note}.
botlist.not_listed: Botlist: {name} was not on the lists.
botlist.deleted: Botlist: {name} removed from the list; now {verdict} according to the automatic rules.
botlist.help: botlist shows the lists; botlist add <name> = always a bot, botlist not <name> = never a bot, botlist del <name> = off the lists, botlist check <name> (admin).

cleanup.stale_none: Cleanup: no silent contacts (repeaters >{repeater_days}d, others >{other_days}d). Oldest unprotected: {oldest}d, {protected} protected, {unknown} without a timestamp.
cleanup.stale_preview: Cleanup: {planned} silent contacts ({shown}{more}). 'cleanup stale now' removes them.
cleanup.stale_done: Cleanup done: {removed}/{planned} silent contacts removed, now {after} contacts.
cleanup.none: Cleanup: {before} contacts, target {target}. Nothing to remove: {protected} protected, {recent} active <{keep_days}d, oldest unprotected {oldest}d.
cleanup.preview: Cleanup: {before} contacts, target {target}: {planned} would be removed ({shown}{more}). 'cleanup now' runs it.
cleanup.help: cleanup shows what would be cleaned up, cleanup now does it; cleanup stale for silent contacts (admin).

dx.help: dx = hop records (week, month, ever); dx top [week|month|ever]; dx me; dx <name>.
dx.no_data: DX ({label}): no messages via repeaters seen yet.
dx.person_none: DX {name}: no message via repeaters seen yet.

pad.help: pad = your message's route in one line: hops, km and repeaters (? = guess). Long version: path.
pad.no_path: No route known for this message.

sig.help: sig = SNR, RSSI and hops of your message with a verdict. Handy for antenna tuning.
sig.no_data: No signal data with this message.

meshkaart.help: meshkaart = how many nodes the bot hears (24h, 7 days, ever). The map itself is on the dashboard.

karma.help: karma <name> = thank someone with a point (max {per_day} a day); karma = your points; karma top = ranking.
karma.self: Giving yourself karma does not count.
karma.unknown: {name} not seen in the last {days} days. Write the name as on the mesh.
karma.limit: You already gave {per_day} karma today. Again tomorrow.
karma.already: {name} already got karma from you today.
karma.no_name: No sender name, cannot give karma.

checkin.help: checkin (or meld) = check in daily and build a streak. checkin top = longest streaks.
checkin.done: Checked in, {name}! Streak {streak} d (best {best}), {today} checked in today.
checkin.again: {name}, you already checked in today. Streak {streak} d (best {best}).
checkin.no_name: No sender name, cannot check in.

prikbord.help: prikbord = newest notes; prikbord <text> = pin one ({days} days); prikbord <nr>; prikbord weg <nr>.
prikbord.empty: The notice board is empty. Pin something with: prikbord <text>
prikbord.not_found: #{id} is not (or no longer) on the board.
prikbord.per_person: You already have {max} notes up. Remove one with: prikbord weg <nr>
prikbord.full: The board is full ({max}). Try later.

noodnummers.help: noodnummers (or nood) = 112 and the help numbers for this region.
noodnummers.reply: Emergency: call 112 (the mesh is no emergency line) | {numbers}

peiling.help: peiling [15m|2h|1d] question | a | b (up to {max} choices), vote with kies <nr>; peiling uitslag; peiling stop.
peiling.usage: Usage: peiling [15m] question | choice 1 | choice 2 (2 to {max} choices)
peiling.none: No poll running on this channel.
peiling.already: A poll is already running. End it first with: peiling stop
peiling.too_long: Too long for one message (max {max} bytes). Shorten the question or choices.

herinner.help: By DM: herinner 30m <text>, herinner 18:30 <text> (also 2h, 1d); herinner lijst; herinner weg <nr>. Max {max} open.
herinner.set_service_off: Reminder #{id} set for {at}, but the Reminders service is off: ask the admin to switch it on.
herinner.max_open: You already have {max} open reminders. Cancel one with: herinner weg <nr>
herinner.no_key: Reminders only work by DM to the bot.

voorspel.help: voorspel = open question; by DM: voorspel nieuw <question> | a | b, voorspel <nr>, voorspel sluit, voorspel uitslag <nr>; voorspel stand.
voorspel.none: No open question. Ask one by DM: voorspel nieuw <question> | a | b
voorspel.show_open: Predict: {question} {choices} ({n} answers, answer by DM: voorspel <nr>)
voorspel.new_usage: Usage: voorspel nieuw <question> | choice 1 | choice 2 (2 to {max} choices)
voorspel.busy: There is already an open question. It needs a result first.
voorspel.created: Question #{id} is open. Share it on the channel; answers go by DM: voorspel <nr>.
voorspel.answered: Noted: {choice}) {text}. You can change it until the question closes.
voorspel.closed: The question is closed, no more answers.
voorspel.closed_now: Closed with {n} answers. Give the result with: voorspel uitslag <nr>
voorspel.not_owner: Only the one who asked can do that.
voorspel.dm_only: Answering and asking go by DM to the bot (that carries your key).

buien.help: buien [place] = rain in the next 2 hours per 10 min (Buienradar, NL/BE). No place: your position or the bot's.
buien.outside: Buienradar only covers the Netherlands and Belgium. Try: rain <place>

xp.help: xp = your level, title and XP; xp <name>; xp top [week]. XP for messages, commands, check-ins, karma and DX.
xp.reply: {name}: level {level} {title}, {xp} XP ({left} to the next level)

badge.help: badge = your milestones on the mesh; badge <name> for someone else.

games.no_bots: {name} is a bot: bots don't take part in the games.

dm.help: Type dm in a channel: the bot sends you a DM, so you can use it privately from then on (help gives the list).
dm.hello: Hi {name}! Send your commands here, help gives the list. Can't see this? Add {bot} as a contact.
dm.already: You're already in a DM with me: type help for the list.
dm.unknown: {name}, I don't know your node yet. Send an advert (flood) and try dm again.

farm.help: farm = Farming Idle by DM: start, sow tomato 2, harvest, sell, make soup, task, market, offer, buy, bank, top
farm.usage: Farming Idle: start, shop, sow, harvest, barn, sell, make, task, market, offer, buy, deliver, cancel, bank, upgrade, give, top
farm.dm_only: Farming Idle is played in a private message, not in a channel. Open a DM with {bot} and send there: farm start
farm.error: Something went wrong on the farm, try again in a moment.
farm.no_farm: You have no farm yet. Send: farm start
farm.already: You already have a farm. Send farm for your status.

farm.unknown_crop: I don't know the crop '{q}'. See farm shop
farm.no_empty: No empty field: a plant gives several harvests. Clear one: farm clear <crop>, or buy: farm upgrade field
farm.no_money: Not enough coins: {need} needed, you have {coins}.
farm.sown: Sown: {n} {crop} ({seeds} own seeds), ripe in {left}. {coins} coins left
farm.sow_usage: Sowing: farm sow <crop> [number], e.g. farm sow tomato 4. See farm shop
farm.nothing_ready: Nothing ripe yet, the first in {left}.
farm.nothing_planted: Nothing on your fields. Sow: farm sow tomato
farm.spent: {n} plant(s) used up, field empty again.
farm.event_storm: Storm: a field of {crop} is lost.
farm.event_thief: Pickpocket: {amount} coins gone. Tip: farm deposit
farm.nothing_to_sell: You have no '{q}' in your barn. See farm barn
farm.sold: Sold: {items} for {coins} coins. You now have {total}.
farm.workshop_full: Your workshop is full ({n} at a time). Wait a bit, or: farm upgrade workshop
farm.bank: Bank: {bank} coins ({rate}% interest a day, max {cap}). Wallet: {coins}. farm deposit <n> / farm withdraw <n>
farm.bad_amount: Which amount? A number up to {max}, or all.
farm.upgrade_max: That upgrade is already at its maximum.
farm.give_self: Giving to yourself makes little sense.
farm.top_empty: No farmers yet. DM me: farm start
farm.quest_done_today: Today's task is done. A new one tomorrow.
farm.market_empty: The market is empty. Offer something: farm offer jam 3 60
farm.offer_usage: Offering: farm offer <crop or product> <number> <price each>, e.g. farm offer jam 3 60
farm.offer_limit: You already have {n} offers. Take one back: farm cancel <nr>
farm.not_in_barn: You only have {have} {item} in your barn.
farm.buy_usage: Buying: farm buy <nr> (see farm market). Taking back: farm cancel <nr>
farm.own_offer: That is your own offer. Take it back: farm cancel {id}
farm.withdrawn: Taken back: {qty} {item} are in your barn again.

quest.harvest: Today's task (for everyone): harvest {need} pieces, any crop ({progress}/{need}). Reward {coins} coins, +{xp} xp.
quest.process: Today's task (for everyone): make {need} products in your workshop ({progress}/{need}). Reward {coins} coins, +{xp} xp.
quest.sell: Today's task (for everyone): sell for {need} coins ({progress}/{need}). Reward {coins} coins, +{xp} xp.

daily_post.harvest: 🌱 Farming Idle, today's task: harvest, any crop counts. Your goal: DM me farm task
daily_post.process: 🌱 Farming Idle, today's task: make products in your workshop. Your goal: DM me farm task
daily_post.sell: 🌱 Farming Idle, today's task: sell your crops. Your goal: DM me farm task

farm.daily_invite: 🌱 Farming Idle: start your own farm today! Open a DM (private message) with {bot} and send there: farm start
farm.no_order: The market does not want {item} now. See farm market
farm.delivered: Delivered: {qty} {item} for {coins} coins. You now have {total}.

farm.shop_hint: Info: farm shop tomaat. Buy seeds for later: farm seeds tomaat 5. Sow: farm sow tomaat
farm.crop_info: {crop} (L{level}): seed {price}, grows {hours}h, {lo}-{hi} per harvest, {times} harvests per plant, sells {sell}. Makes: {made}
farm.seeds_bought: Bought {n} {crop} seeds for {cost}. In your barn: {have}. {coins} coins left

farm.cleared: {n} field(s) cleared. Sow something new: farm sow <crop>

farm.dm_invite_player: Hi {name}! This is where you play Farming Idle. Send in this DM: farm (your farm) or farm task
farm.dm_sent: @[{name}] I sent you a DM, play on there.
farm.season_you: You: place {rank}, {points} points (farm XP this month). Top 3 win {rewards} coins.

farm.season_off: Seasons are off on this bot.
farm.season_none: No season is running now. The admin sets the next one on the dashboard.

discover.none: No direct neighbours known yet (scan: BotNetwork/PacketCapture card). New scan by DM: neighbors

ha.not_admin: ha is only for the admin of this bot.

refused.self: Mail to yourself does not work.
refused.too_many: You already have {n} messages waiting. Try later.

post.error: Something went wrong with the mail, try again in a moment.
